{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (sentinel for missing QC)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the result
print(f'Final number of patients after deduplication and removing -999: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Display the first few rows of the cleaned data
df_dedup.head()"}
